source_value.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen recording that plays itself. Inside it a drawn white pointer does the work — it opens each "Select" dropdown in the Welcome to Intercom modal (first at ~18s, department at ~36s, role at ~42s), reaches "Save and continue" at 48.0s and presses it by 49.0s, then travels down the collapsed Inbox rail from Fin AI Agent to Knowledge between 86s and 89s.
source_value.start_state: A Gmail message "Phil has invited you to work together on Intercom" with a "Join your team" button (0-0.25s), which crossfades to the "Join your team on Intercom" signup page carrying Sign Up with Google, Your name, Work email and "Password (at least 15 characters)" fields.
source_value.end_state: The Intercom Messenger home panel "Hi, Sara! How can we help?" listing "Let's have a conversation", "Send us a message", "Order status" and a "Find an answer quickly" search field, beside the zoomed Inbox rail (89.5-90.0s).
source_value.continuity: One 90.00s render at 30 fps (2700 counted frames). Motion inside a scene is continuous — the pointer travels, dropdown menus expand in place, and across 46.0-48.75s the four modal answers stay on screen while the cursor moves down to the Save and continue button — and scenes are joined by short dissolves rather than hard cuts: the signup page dims behind a light outline around the Sign Up with Google block at ~2.5-3.75s, and the modal dissolves through a "We'll be right with you..." interstitial at 49.25s into the "Join your team on Inbox" page at 49.5s. No still-image interpolation.
source_value.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer in the same frame: each chosen dropdown value replaces the placeholder word "Select" in the modal (three answers standing at 45.0s, all four including "Support Rep" by 47.0s), the Save and continue button darkens under the pointer at 48.5-49.0s, a "We'll be right with you..." line covers the wait at 49.25s, and the Inbox counters report the outcome as numerals (Your inbox 0, Created by you 3, header "0 Open") at 75.6s.
